author: EJR
title: Hiring top-tier illustrator for brand launch
content:
I’m looking for one more top-tier illustrator for approximately two/three weeks of work.

You’ll collaborate with world-renowned Chief Creative Officer @kaipham , @Sloppy_Studios , five exceptional illustrators, and me on an ambitious brand launch.

If your work is not currently at the level of @inkartluis or @Artlv12 or you don’t have experience illustrating for major companies or brands such as Azuki, please do not apply for this particular role.

We’ll have opportunities for artists across a wider range of styles and skill levels in approximately one month.

If your work is not at the level of the images I’m posting, please do not comment.
